title: Learning at any age
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le és hasonlítsd össze a képeket, fejtsd ki a véleményedet a megadott szempontok alapján, majd beszélgess a vizsgáztatóval a tanulásról, a vizsganyomásról és az egész életen át tartó tanulásról.

scenes.description: It is ten o'clock at night, and a seventeen-year-old girl is sitting at the desk in her bedroom. She is having an online maths lesson with a private tutor, who appears on her laptop screen. Around her there are piles of practice tests, highlighters and an empty energy drink can. She is rubbing her eyes and looks exhausted.

In a bright classroom at a community centre, about ten adults of different ages, from their twenties to their seventies, are attending an evening Spanish course. Two of them, a young man in a suit and a grey-haired woman, are doing a role-play at a pretend café counter, and the rest of the group are laughing. The teacher is clapping. Nobody seems to be under pressure.

prompts: Compare the two learning situations and the feelings of the learners.
Why do so many Hungarian students take private lessons?
What motivates people to keep learning as adults?
followUpQuestions: Is it ever too late to learn a new language or skill? Why?
Does the school system put too much pressure on teenagers? In what way?
How could schools prepare students better for exams without private tutors?
What would you like to learn later in life, just for fun?
